findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_fx_rates, get_my_portfolio · Private data: enter_competition · Public sink: place_order, claim_referral_code, get_my_referrals.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_fx_rates, get_my_portfolio · Private data: enter_competition · Public sink: place_order, claim_referral_code, get_my_referrals

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
